counterexamples.required_result: A cycle is refused as cycle; two references to one object are not a cycle.
isBoundaryValue agrees with the issue list.
Array order is semantic and member order is not.
Equality is over canonical bytes: two spellings of one value agree, and a number is not its text.
String length is counted in Unicode scalar values: the limit passes, one over is refused, astral scalars count once.
The same scalar limit applies to member names.
Depth counts containers on a path, with empty containers counting: 32 passes and 33 is refused.
A value nested 50,000 deep is refused as too_deep rather than exhausting the stack.
